data.narrative:
RMFG, a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company, has raised $4.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparison universe of nine private robotics firms and one public peer (277810.KQ), though narrow peer matching constraints limit applicability of certain methods.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, using the $4.5M total raised as a proxy base value. This yields an implied valuation of $11M. Peer-median comparison is not applicable; while ten same-sector peers exist in robotics and manufacturing, the sample lacks sufficient narrow-filter matches (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier), requiring a minimum of three datapoints for reliable benchmarking. Falling back to all-sector medians would introduce unwarranted noise.

Given the single applicable method, the triangulated valuation range is $10M (low) to $13M (high), with a median of $11M. This range reflects reasonable variance around stage-progression convention. Key uncertainties include the absence of calibrated peer multiples specific to RMFG's technology focus and the reliance on a single methodological anchor. Additional private or public comparable transactions at similar development stages in frontier robotics would materially strengthen conviction in this range.
